title: Himachal Pradesh High Court confers Senior Advocate designation on 15 lawyers
description: The Himachal Pradesh High Court has conferred senior designation on 15 advocates including one woman lawyer.The High Court announced the decision in a notification issued on July 10. The lawyers designated as senior advocates are:Ajay Chandel;Akhil Sain Chopra;Arvind Sharma;Deepak Gupta;Desh Raj;Karan Singh Kanwar;Manoj Pathak;Onkar Nath Jairath;Rahul Gupta;Ram Murti Bisht;Shubh Mahajan;Sumeet Raj Sharma;Surender Kumar Sharma;Vikas Rathore;Vikrant Thakur.[Read Notification]Himachal Pradesh High
